name: rustfairyochre
title: Rust Gold 8 + FairyRust_8x + Ochre Ruin
author: Trigo Mathmancer, KRYPTOCCULTIST and Quemis
note: pooled from Rust Gold 8 by Trigo Mathmancer, FairyRust_8x by KRYPTOCCULTIST (lospec.com/palette-list/fairyrust8x) and Ochre Ruin by Quemis (lospec.com/palette-list/ochre-ruin)
commentary: Three sources, twenty-eight colours, and the only one of the three Rust Gold unions that needs a single addition beyond orange and pink. Ochre Ruin's nine neutrals give a real grey ramp, FairyRust the blues and purples, Rust Gold the warm half.

The cost is that almost everything is muted: Ochre Ruin sits at chroma 3-17 throughout, so the palette separates by lightness rather than hue, and the slots that do collide collide hard. darkgreen was the source's own #30322d until measurement showed it two L from darkred and collapsing under both protanopia and deuteranopia; relighting it off the palette's own teal-green costs one sourced slot and removes three of the four collapses. That trade is the one judgement call in this mapping worth arguing with.
